items.statement: Target AdBlue volume growth of 10% to 15%
items.quote: You'll see, we have been looking at 10% to 15% growth in the segment. I think that is where we see it.

items.statement: Tirex revenue to more than double FY24 levels in FY25 and continue doubling for next 1-2 years
items.quote: We should definitely, end the year on more than double of last year revenues and trajectory for the next 1-2 years also remains that way.

items.statement: Early signs of demand recovery seen in Q3 FY25
items.quote: We are also seeing some early signs of demand recovery , so that's really one of the highlights.

items.statement: Factory fill business showing traction from December with uptick expected in coming quarters
items.quote: As we speak, there is a traction, which is coming back in the factory fill business , and because of which overall DEO volumes are also in the mid -single-digit growth last quarter, but we are seeing an uptick there clearly from the factory fill side.

items.statement: Q3 FY25 EBITDA margin at 13.5%, up 90 bps sequentially
items.quote: As Ravi mentioned, we had a very healthy performance for Q3, with a double-digit revenue growth and EBITDA of INR 120 crore, which translated into an EBITDA margin at 13.5%, a sequential basis improvement of nearly 90 basis points.

items.statement: Gross margin improved sequentially due to product mix and stable input costs despite rupee depreciation
items.quote: On the gross margin side, also, you will see that there is an improvement sequentially at the gross margin level, which me ans that the input costs have been relatively stable, although there was a depreciation of the rupee.

items.statement: Took one price increase of ~2% in Q1 FY25; no further hikes due to stable rupee and base oil
items.quote: If you recall, I think there was only one price increase Q1. Thereafter, there have been no price increases because rupee and base oil have been very stable.

items.statement: Will take pricing actions or scheme adjustments if rupee depreciation persists to neutralize input cost impact
items.quote: definitely pricing actions and/or scheme related adjustments will come in, which will neutralize part of the impact of this input cost increase.

items.statement: Base oil prices stable as crude remains in $75-80 range; landed cost impacted by rupee depreciation
items.quote: As long as the crude remains in this trajectory of $75 to $80, the input costs should remain stable. Of course, the base oil follow with a lag and there is a demand -supply situation in various grades of base oil , but largely, we are hopeful that with crude stability the base oil prices remain stable, but the landed cost due to rupee depreciation obviously goes up.

items.statement: High proportion of Group II and Group III base oils used for premium and long-drain products
items.quote: We have been one of the large consumers of Group II, Group III base oil because all of our premium grades, and long-drain products are based on Group II, Group III formulation, so yes, the proportion of Group II Group III base oil is quite high in our overall portfolio.

items.statement: Tirex has healthy order pipeline and on track to close FY25 strongly
items.quote: Healthy order pipeline is there, and we are on track to close the year on a strong note in this business, which is going to add to us.

items.statement: Annual capex guided at INR 30-40 crore; evaluating expansion at Silvassa plant
items.quote: Our trajectory of capex has been around INR 30 crore annually. Going forward, we estimate to have a capex of around INR 30 crore to INR 40 crore. We are, of course, running our plants at around 100% capacity, and we have purchased some adjoining land near our Silvassa plant as well, which is connected to our plant, so we look for an expansion plan there as well.

items.statement: Renewed exclusive Piaggio partnership till 2032 (2W) and 2030 (CV); added 2W high-performance sports bike range
items.quote: We renewed our exclusive partnership with Piaggio India till 2032 and continue to deliver high-quality lubricants across the ranges and have even added 2-wheeler range of high -performance sports bikes. We ’ve obviously got this partnership until 2032, and we have also extended our long -term partnership with Piaggio for the Commercial Vehicle segment up to 2030.

items.statement: Strategic partnership with Nayara for 6,000 retail outlets; exclusive AdBlue arrangement
items.quote: We had the strategic partnership with Nayara, where we are expanding to their network of 6,000 outlets. We are already selling lubricants there and AdBlue will also get sold, and this is definitely going to help us create availability. This process has now started.

items.statement: Working capital improved by 5-6 days in Q3 FY25
items.quote: Our working capital has improved from the last quarter by nearly around 5 -6 days.

items.statement: Net cash position of INR 450+ crore as of December 2024; debt-free
items.quote: At the net debt level, we continue to remain a debt-free company with net cash position now upwards of INR 450 crore at the end of December.

items.statement: Core lubricant volume 38,500 kl in Q3 FY25, up 7% YoY; AdBlue volume 36,000 kl
items.quote: 38,500 kl is the core lubricant volume for the quarter and AdBlue is at 36,000 kl.

items.statement: Declared interim dividend of INR 20 per share (1,000% on face value of INR 2)
items.quote: I'd like t o also end by mentioning that we have declared a very good return to our shareholders in terms of an interim dividend of INR 20 per share, which is 1,000% on the face value of INR 2.

items.statement: Forex loss of INR 5 crore in Q3 and INR 3.5 crore YTD due to rupee depreciation on working capital loans
items.quote: The only thing you will see also in the results published is t hat the Quarter-on-Quarter finance cost has gone up, and that is because of the forex loss due to rupee depreciation, on our working capital loans, which had an impact of around INR 5 crore for this quarter. Although first H1, we were having a net forex gain. For the YTD 9 Month period, we are at nearly INR 3.5 crore of forex loss.

items.statement: Rupee depreciation since November impacting landed base oil costs; monitoring closely
items.quote: rupee, which started during the quarter and continues as we speak. Obviously, that requires a margin management to kick in

items.statement: Targets 1.5x industry growth; industry expected to grow 6-7% in FY26
items.quote: we would definitely want to grow 1.5x the industry. So while the industry is expected to grow about 6% to 7% over the next financial year, we are in position in order to achieve our goals and targets.

items.statement: Expects EBITDA margin to be stable and then grow from current 11.5%
items.quote: On the EBITDA side, we have come over the past few years on consistent and sustainable numbers. So while we are very happy to share that we have done an all -time high percentage, we expect this to be stable and then grow in the times to come.

items.statement: Targets exports to reach 15% of revenue in mid to long term from current 8-10%
items.quote: Currently, we are about 8% to 10% of our revenue. And as an organization, we would like to grow this much higher than t he domestic growth. So while we have the order book, we would like to take it to about 15% in the midterm to long run for our overall revenue side.

items.statement: Lifetime order wins in Q3 exceeded INR 1,250 crores with EV platforms contributing over 25%
items.quote: Key recent developments include order wins in Q3, and lifetime order wins exceeding INR 1,250 crores with EV platforms contributing over 25% of these wins.

items.statement: Nine-month order book surpassed INR 6,000 crores reflecting expanding portfolio and premiumization
items.quote: For the first nine months of the year, our order book surpassed INR 6,000 crores, reflecting an expanding product portfolio, product premiumization, and rising demand for both ICE and EV products across customers and across segments.

items.statement: Q3 EBITDA margin hit all-time high of 11.5%, up 32 bps YoY
items.quote: We achieved the highest-ever EBITDA margin at 11.5% with a growth of 32 basis points year-on-year basis.

items.statement: 9M EBITDA margin at 11.3%, up from 10.9% YoY
items.quote: On a nine months basis, the revenue has grown from INR 3,436 crores to INR 3,735 crores, which is a 9% growth, whereas the EBITDA has grown by 12% from INR 376 crores to INR 422 crores for the first nine months and has an EBITDA margin from 10.9% to a sustainable 11.3%.

items.statement: Highest capex expected in die-casting division and electronics across verticals over next 2-3 years
items.quote: Yes. So in our portfolio, the highest capex comes primarily from the die -casting division. And that is where the highest investment is probably expected. Also in the areas of Electronics, which is, again, across various segments, or across various verticals because everything is becoming more electronics per se.

items.statement: R&D spend at ~4% of sales (opex+capex) in FY25 and expected to continue in FY26
items.quote: Now as an opex and capex put together, we are investing close to about 4% or north of 4% in the R&D. And this year, of course, in the FY26 also, we expect to continue in a similar range.

items.statement: Post Flash deal, net debt/equity at 0.6x and pro forma net debt/EBITDA <1.8x
items.quote: Post this, the net debt to equity in the short term will be 0.6x, and pro forma net debt to pro forma EBITDA is less than 1.8x.

items.statement: Expects INR 500-600 crores cross-selling revenue from Minda-Flash synergies by 2030
items.quote: So, we expect by 2030, this number is in the range of about INR 500 crores to INR 600 crores.

items.statement: Smart keys at 7-8% of Vehicle Access revenue; expected to grow consistently with new launches
items.quote: in terms of the smart keys, this continues to be about 7% to 8% of our revenue of our Vehicle Access division. And in the next quarters to come, this is expected to grow on a consistent basis, while there are new launches, product launches as well as more penetration increases in the ICE as well as EV vehicles.

items.statement: TFT clusters at 8-10% of Minda Instruments portfolio; larger penetration expected in 4-wheeler segment
items.quote: Currently, in our Minda Instruments portfolio, this also continues to be about close to 8% to 10% of our revenue when it comes to the new or next -generation clusters with this TFT in the various sizes, which are connected and other electronics in the driver information system space. Going forward, they will be h aving a larger penetration in the 4 -wheeler segment on the TFT side.

items.statement: EV products at 5-6% of Minda standalone revenue; 10-12% combined with Flash; Flash itself >20% EV revenue
items.quote: Currently, if you look at 2-wheeler industry per se, penetration is about 5% to 6% on the overall industry. And at Minda Corporation, also the EV platforms or products are about 5% to 6% of our overall revenue. Of course, when you now combine in Flash, this is much higher, close to about 10% to 12%. And in terms of Flash Electronics itself, it is a much higher portfolio. More than 20% of the reven

items.statement: Wiring harness connector localization at 15-16% from internal division; imports down to 50% from higher levels
items.quote: In the last two quarters, the connectors consumption coming out of Minda Corporation connector division for our wiring harness has come to about 15%. And so the dependence on imports has constantly gone down. And now the imports stand at about 50% and domestic is about 50%, out of which 15% to 16% is the domestic consumption coming from Minda Corporation design and development capabilities.

items.statement: CV industry expected to bounce back with single-digit growth in next few quarters
items.quote: So, we believe that the CV industry should bounce back in the next recent quarters to come. But of course, we are expecting a single-digit growth in the next few quarters. As per our planning, that's what we look at.

items.statement: 4-wheeler segment expected to grow modestly to 7-8 million vehicles by 2030
items.quote: And all the reports show that the 4-wheeler is expected to be about 7 million to 8 million vehicles by 2030. So, a modest growth is expected over the next few years.

items.statement: Exports revenue flat QoQ after YoY decline; evaluating geopolitical opportunities and challenges
items.quote: Yes. I think in the past year-on-year basis, our exports as a revenue have been going down, but happy to share that on a quarter-on-quarter basis, it is flat. As we have shared whatever ways we could expect they are there. But of course, with the new geopolitical concerns, it is in somewhere opening us opportunities. But of course, somewhere they could become challenged in terms of the American ma

items.statement: Comfortable with current 0.6x debt/equity; generating enough free cash flow to reduce debt going forward
items.quote: So I think the current debt level is going to be about 0.6x our debt-to-equity ratio, which is well within our comfortable financial prudence that we have set for our organization. And going forward, of course, there will be various options that one can evaluate. And more importantly, Minda Corporation is generating enough free cash flow and cash gen erating to look at how we can reduce this going

items.statement: Board recommended interim dividend of 25% on face value
items.quote: Based on this, the Board of Directors has recommended an interim dividend of 25% on the face value.

items.statement: Union budget seen as progressive and growth-oriented, expected to boost auto industry
items.quote: The union budget announced by the Honorable Finance Minister is a progressive and growth -oriented budget, and we are very confident th at this will further boost the Indian automotive industry and Indian economy, of course, giving opportunities for Minda Corporation.

items.statement: Flash Electronics growing at 17-18% constantly; expected to continue in similar range
items.quote: Flash Electronics has been growing at a constant rate of about 17% to 18%, and we expect them to grow in a simila r range in the next few quarters to come.

items.statement: Filed 17 patents in 9M FY25; total patent count now 290+
items.quote: In the first nine months, we filed 17 patents and now the patent count is 290 plus.

items.statement: New product electronics increasing import content, especially semiconductors, until local availability improves
items.quote: when it comes to the new product lines, yes, the import content when the new products are coming in, such as more electronics is going to increase, particularly on the semiconductors. So until they are made available locally in India, we have to be reliant on global companies.

items.statement: Sunroof and closure system products under testing and validation at a couple of customers
items.quote: Yes. So we have been under discussion and our products are under testing validation at a couple of customers. So as and when there is a further development, I'll let you know.

items.statement: Manufacturing PMI softened; festive demand in October lower than expected; November and December saw marginal slowdown impacting freight movement.
items.quote: The festive season demand in October was lower than expected, while November and December saw a marginal slowdown, impacting overall freight movement.

items.statement: Annual toll revisions of 8% to 10% and increased labour and transport costs added pressure on operating expenses.
items.quote: Inflationary factors, including annual toll revisions of 8% to 10% and increased labour and transport cos ts added pressure on operating expenses

items.statement: Planning to achieve 20% to 22% revenue share from Multimodal Logistics in the next two to three years.
items.quote: The contribution from Multimodal Services is steadily increasing, and we are planning to achieve a 20% to 22% revenue share from Multimodal Logistics in the next two to three years.

items.statement: Incurred Rs. 20 crores capex in nine months FY25, including Rs. 9.38 crores in Q3 FY25, for branch network, sorting centers and IT infrastructure.
items.quote: During nine months '25, we incurred a Capex of Rs. 20 crores, including Rs. 9.38 crores in Q3 '25, primarily directed towards expanding our branch network, constructing sorting centers and ramping up IT infrastructure.

items.statement: Next year FY26 capex visibility of around Rs. 110 crores.
items.quote: But next year, we have very clear visibility for the Capex of around Rs. 110 crores.

items.statement: Capacity utilization stable at 82% for nine months FY25; highest achieved in a quarter was 84.5%.
items.quote: Our strong customer mix, extensive network and market positioning enabled us to maintain stable capacity utilization at 82%.

items.statement: Board recommended second interim dividend of Rs. 3 per share, taking total dividend to Rs. 6 per share for the year.
items.quote: Furthering our commitment to shareholder value, the Board has recommended an interim dividend of Rs. 3 per share, reinforcing our confidence in the company's financial stability and growth prospects.

items.statement: Payable days 35, receivable days 58, net working capital requirement 22 days; cash flow from operations Rs. 40 crores in nine months FY25.
items.quote: So again, if you see payable days are 35 days, receivable days is 58. So the net working capital requirement is in the range of 22 days.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with strong cash flow generation.
items.quote: Our debt-free balance sheet and disciplined financial management have resulted in a strong cash flow generation with Rs. 40 crores cash flow from operations during the period.

items.statement: Targeting 12% to 15% value growth and 10% to 12% volume growth in FY26; intend to take price hikes next year.
items.quote: So we've taken a target wise to grow in value-wise in the range of 12% to 15%. Volume wise, we will grow like double-digit at least 10% to 12%.

items.statement: Q3 FY25 EBITDA margin at 11%; nine months EBITDA and PAT declined around 27% YoY; margin erosion of ~300 bps seen sustainable at current level.
items.quote: These are the Q3 highlights where we achieved a revenue of almost Rs. 300 crores with EBITDA of Rs. 33 crores, which is at 11% margin and profit after tax is Rs. 21 crores.

items.statement: Got price impact of 25-30 bps in Q3; from January getting good price hikes from big customers; targeting ~1% overall price hike (100 bps) in Q4 FY25.
items.quote: In this quarter also, we're getting a benefit of like getting a price impact of 25 to 30 basis points. But from January onwards, we're getting good price hikes from the customer.

items.statement: Volume reduced by almost 3% in Q3 FY25; Q3 volume was 242,000 tonnes; January saw growth but March uncertain.
items.quote: Yes. So Alok, volume is reduced by almost 3% in this quarter.

items.statement: Revenue mix shifted to 53% big customers, 47% SME in Q3 (vs 51/49 in nine months); SME slowdown hurting volumes and margins.
items.quote: In Q3, it is also slightly different. It is almost 53% big customer, 47% SME customers. That's one of reasons to decline in our margin levels.

items.statement: Aggressively focusing on big customers to improve fill factor; plan to return to 50-50 mix once SME normalizes.
items.quote: So we also like exactly more focusing on a big customer there wherever we have, and we're really getting good response on that side. So aggressively, we're pushing to be more focused on a big customer rather than SMEs.

items.statement: Automation implemented at Gurgaon and Pune sorting centers; Ahmedabad and Kolkata automation by end FY26 or Q1 FY27; construction starting before March end.
items.quote: Next, we will be, I think at the end of next year or maybe like first quarter of FY '27, we will be implement ing the automation in Ahmedabad and Kolkata. We have already finalized the contractor and soon we will be starting before even March end, we will start the construction in two facilities

items.statement: Automation at two sorting centers reduced cost by 30-50 bps overall; will add automation in new centers (Kolkata, Ahmedabad, then Chennai, Mumbai).
items.quote: So ultimately, we reduced the cost by like 30 to 50 basis points put together in these 2 centres in overall basis.

items.statement: Multimodal services (Air, Rail, Cold Chain) contribute 17-18% of revenue; Surface is remainder; B2C share shrunk to 2.5-3% from 4%.
items.quote: So, all put together, services are still stagnant at 17.5% to 17% to 18% and remaining is surface.

items.statement: Union Budget 25-26 measures: PM Gati Shakti database access to optimize routes, air cargo infra upgrades, social scheme for gig workers to improve talent and service quality.
items.quote: Access to the PM Gati Shakti database will optimize route planning, reduce transit times and lower operational costs. Air cargo infrastructure upgrades will enhance express delivery efficiency, reducing lead times.

items.statement: Board approved $7.5 million investment in Singapore subsidiary over FY26-27 for freight forwarding hub; 10-15% of cash flow each year.
items.quote: Well, so first, this new capital requirement is not for this year, it is for like '25-'26 and '26-'27 for the two year. So overall cash flow will not be more than like in the range of 10% to 15% each year.

items.statement: Plan to open 50-75 branches in FY26 and 75-100 in FY27; 30-40% of new branches to support Multimodal business.
items.quote: So next year, again, we will be planning to open a branch in the range of 50 to 75. And in '26 '27, again, in the range of 75 to 100 that surely we will be open that branches.

items.statement: Competitors (Blue Dart, Gati, VRL) not growing volumes; some took price hikes but volume growth matched price; TCI Express maintains highest PAT margin in industry.
items.quote: I think whatever name you've taken for the competition, they're also not growing in volumes, either they're growing through the price hikes, other companies you said, taken so much price and that growth was also equal to that.

items.statement: E-way bill site closure on last day of December impacted Q3 volume by 1.5-2%; SME slowdown may persist 3-6 months depending on RBI rate cuts and inflation.
items.quote: December month is again always the best month, but we've not seen that kind of even degrowth on that month. That was one-of reason also where e-way bill site has closed on the last day. So that has also impacted my volume in this quarter at least 1.5% to 2% on that particular day.

items.statement: Achieved Great Place to Work certification for fifth consecutive year (2025-26).
items.quote: we are proud to have again achieved the Great Place to Work '25-'26 certification again for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring our commitment to fostering a positive and employee-friendly work culture.

items.statement: Rail Express uses passenger trains (not goods trains) for door-to-door service at 25% cost of air with similar TAT; 150 routes, 5,000 customer base growing fast.
items.quote: Yeah, it is again, it's like substitute of air services, where they're giving whatever prices, and we're doing this rail services in like 25% cost and with the same kind of TAT where we're putting our material into passenger train and then delivering.

items.statement: Industry search queries dropped 8% per Google report; member registrations fell in line with industry trend
items.quote: As per Google report on the matrimony industry, the whole industry has seen an 8% drop in search queries for the first ever time.

items.statement: Expect Matchmaking billing growth QoQ in Q4 FY25; revenue to decline due to muted Q3 billing; Marriage Services similar to Q3
items.quote: On the billing and revenue output for quarter 4, we expect a growth in Matchmaking billing in quarter 4 on a quarter-over-quarter basis. However, the revenue is expected to decline are due to the muted billing growth in quarter 3.

items.statement: Matchmaking EBITDA margin 18.7% in Q3 vs 22.6% in Q2 and 18.9% YoY; consolidated EBITDA margin 12.4% vs 15.2% QoQ and 14.3% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the Matchmaking business in Q3 is at 18.7% as compared to 22.6% in quarter 2 and 18.9% a year ago

items.statement: Excluding marketing, Matchmaking margins improved to 61% from 59% YoY; expect PAT lower in Q4 due to subdued momentum
items.quote: Excluding marketing expenses, our margins in Matchmaking are at 61% as compared to 59% a year ago, a slight improvement in margins excluding marketing expenses.

items.statement: Long-term EBITDA margin can comfortably exceed 25%; PAT margin can reach 20%+ as marketing costs normalize
items.quote: EBITDA -- but overall, I think that's the one. And EBITDA level definitely can easily comfortably go beyond 25% also.

items.statement: Average transaction value increased 2.4% QoQ and 5.1% YoY due to pricing strategies and personalized services mix
items.quote: In terms of what is the increase in ARPU reason, the mix -- one is about our pricing strategies and also some mix of changes for on account of personalized services moving up.

items.statement: Launching vernacular apps (Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam live; more languages soon) and new community matrimony app version this month
items.quote: We are launching a new version of community matrimony apps sometime this month. We have a lot of community-based matrimony apps.

items.statement: Leadership in South, West, East; North India penetration push with combined BharatMatrimony and CommunityMatrimony launch this month
items.quote: this month is going to have both BharatMatrimony as well as CommunityMatrimony in North India, because we feel okay, why not grow combin ation of BharatMatrimony and CommunityMatrimony in North India

items.statement: Industry reaches ~10M users annually vs 60M seeking partners; vernacular apps and new initiatives to drive top-of-funnel growth
items.quote: While you are talking about the overall industry put together, the entire reach may be around 10 million users per annum compared to 60 million people are looking for a life partner.

items.statement: Competitor growth due to reverting from free-service model to prior paid model; industry trend broad-based per Google data
items.quote: So basically, they have gone back to the earlier trajectory what they had prior to the decision what they had taken to offer a service as a free service.

items.statement: Cost optimization planned for Q1 FY26; marketing spend could drop to INR30-35 crores/quarter from INR47 crores if competition eases
items.quote: We will definitely see some kind of optimization forward, that's going to happen. If you look at what is our marketing spend, I think it can be even easily instead of say INR47 crores, probably you can even even INR35 crores if the competition goes down.

items.statement: Cash balance INR315 crores after buyback; operating cash flow to EBITDA conversion 100%; ROCE 10.4%
items.quote: Cash balance is at INR315 crores. It declined as compared to Q2 due to the buyback that we just concluded in Q3. However, operating cash flow generation to EBITDA has been robust at 100%.

items.statement: Buyback concluded in Q3 FY25 reducing cash balance
items.quote: Cash balance is at INR315 crores. It declined as compared to Q2 due to the buyback that we just concluded in Q3.

items.statement: CFO Sushanth Pai departing; CEO praises his contribution and wishes him well
items.quote: Yes, he's done a great job and definitely I wish him all the best. He's one of the leaders who have done a good contribution to Matrimony.

items.statement: Matchmaking paid subscriptions 2.38 lakhs, down 3.7% QoQ and 9.7% YoY; 27,700 success stories created
items.quote: We added 2.38 lakhs paid subscriptions during the quarter, a decline of 3.7% quarter-over-quarter and 9.7% year-on-year.

items.statement: Revival timing uncertain; may take 1-2 quarters or longer into next financial year; industry decline cause unknown
items.quote: we are def initely hopeful of revival in the coming year, the coming financial year, whether 1 or 2 quarters down the line, maybe a little longer also. But we are hopeful of early revival taking longer time

items.statement: New initiatives (jobs, astrology, luv.com) at early stage; jobs platform in Tamil Nadu with ~2 lakh resumes targeting 5M resumes and 10K+ employers
items.quote: We intend to monetize once we reach our 5 million resumes, once we reach probably 10,000 plus employers. And we already have close to a couple of lakhs of resumes and it's going on fine.

items.statement: New initiative losses expected in similar INR10-12 crore range; monetization planned after reaching scale
items.quote: Broadly, it is the same range, but once you see some traction, once you are able to see some phenomenal growth, once you are able to get a certain thing right, at that poi nt, I come back to ask, what is the initiative to drive the growth

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue target to INR7,200 crores from INR6,300 crores due to new clients CaratLane, Aditya Birla and P.N. Gadgil
items.quote: Yes, already we were at INR6,300 crores. Now we are guiding at INR7,300 crores as we are already reaching out of INR3,300 crores, we have already done INR2,500 crores. So we have changed our guidance to INR7,200 crores because these are clients we have not counted in our guidance of INR6,300 crores.

items.statement: FY26 revenue guidance revised to INR5,700 crores and FY27 to INR7,200 crores
items.quote: INR5,700 crores for FY '26 and INR7,200 crores for FY '27.

items.statement: FY25 revenue target of INR3,300 crores maintained, Q4 expected to be better than Q3
items.quote: We have delivered a strong performance in the first 9 months for the financial year and remain on track to achieve our annual revenue target of INR3,300 crores driven by new client acquisition opera tion efficiencies and enhanced management

items.statement: FY27 margin targets: gross margin 7%, EBITDA 5.5%, PAT 3.5%
items.quote: So gross margins, we are expecting to be at 7%, EBITDA at 5.5% and 3.5% PAT.

items.statement: Expect blended gross margins to reach 7-8% in next 3-6 quarters as lab-grown diamond grows to 5% of revenue
items.quote: I think blended margins will be at 7/8% and EBITDA at 5.5% and PAT at 3.5%.

items.statement: Wedding jewellery demand remains strong despite gold price fluctuations; 18-carat and lab-grown diamond segments gaining traction
items.quote: Demand for wedding jewellery remains strong despite fluctuation in gold prices with customers adopting to market changes. Sky Gold diversification into new jewellery segment has gained strong transition this quarter, further strengthening our market presence.

items.statement: Retail demand impact of 10-15% for 5-7 days when gold prices spike, then normalizes; 18-carat demand increasing as budget-friendly option
items.quote: At retail level, there is 10%, 15% of impact is there for a short term of 10 to 15 days. But I think nowadays, as and when gold rates from youngsters want to buy the gold as they presume that gold will go to INR1 lakh or something, there is an assumption in the market.

items.statement: Onboarded Aditya Birla Novel Jewels' Indriya brand, CaratLane and P.N. Gadgil as new clients; CaratLane delivering 20 kg/month, Aditya Birla started deliveries in Q3
items.quote: This quarter, we successfully onboarded Aditya Birla Novel Jewels' Indriya brand, marking a significant milestone that highlights our ability to cater large-scale premium projects. Additionally, we strengthened our presence among major jewellery retailers by partnering with CaratLane and P.N. Gadgil in the past quarter.

items.statement: Expect 50 kg/month each from CaratLane and Aditya Birla from April quarter, adding 100 kg to regular production
items.quote: So we are expecting monthly 50-50 kg from both CaratLane and Aditya. This will add 100 kg extra production from our regular guidance.

items.statement: Tanishq onboarding in progress, regular meetings ongoing, positive vendor reviews from CaratLane relationship helping
items.quote: So it will help us to onboard Tanishq also. We are regularly meeting them. Alre ady our Vice President, Akash Talesara is targeting them. Already we meet twice in last week also but we are expecting let's see in a quarter, we will -- but we are able to achieve Novel Jewels, Aditya Birla onboard then CaratLane. Now Tanishq is the only remaining part, so we are very nearby

items.statement: Targeting Reliance and Tanishq as clients who provide raw material, reducing capital employed
items.quote: We are targeting Reliance also for that and already Tanishq is in pipeline. So we are targeting them also. So we are concentrating those clients who are providing us raw material.

items.statement: Raised INR270 crores recently; INR70 crores used in subsidiaries, INR140 crores in subsidiaries, INR100 crores in Sky Gold, INR30 crores general corporate; invested in 18-carat, natural diamond, lab-grown diamond

items.statement: Current borrowings INR380-400 crores as of December; target INR550-600 crores by FY26 end; Gold Metal Loan (GML) conversion target 55-60% by March, 75-80% by FY26

items.quote: So yes, we are expecting by March end 60%, 70%. We were expecting by December, we are a little bit slower by one quarter because of some -- Karur Vysya Bank has closed their model, so we have to ship to ICICI Bank. SBI is also on the process.

items.statement: 18-carat revenue share increased from 3% to 4-5% in Q3; natural diamond carats doubled from 400 to 883; lab-grown diamond first shipment to Limelight Jewellery (25 stores)

This quarter, we sold 883 carats of diamonds.

items.statement: Export revenue INR71 crores in Q3 (7% of revenue), up 12% QoQ; appointed distributor in Singapore; UAE demand stable, targeting 13-15% export share by FY27
items.quote: Exports continue to make healthy contributions with sales reaching INR71 crores, marking a 12% growth as compared to previous quarter.

items.statement: India Ratings (Fitch subsidiary) assigned IND A-/Stable rating to bank loans; fund-based working capital limits rated IND A-/Stable/IND A2+; expected to reduce cost of funds and collateral requirements

items.statement: Strengthened leadership team with industry veterans across plant heads, sales heads, designers; total employees 950 (up from 600); hiring at worker level, technology reducing manpower needs

items.statement: Other income INR3.3 crores from investment sales and INR2.4 crores interest income in Q3; INR35 crores shares with SBI in release process
items.quote: So INR35 crores of shares are lying with SBI, they are in the release process. If they get released, we'll get -- we already got in this quarter also INR3.3 crores from the sales of investments and INR2.4 crores from the interest income.

items.statement: Lab-grown diamond prices falling quarterly; mitigate by ordering inventory only against fixed customer orders, same model as natural diamonds
items.quote: Sure. So I will throw a light on that because lab-grown is a devaluating asset every time -- every quarter rates are falling. Earlier, it was falling drastically. items.quote: So we are expecting to 650 kg approximately, 650 to 700 kg. So as we told that we'll update new PPT guidance also in this 7 days and in our actions also. So I think we are expecting to 650 kg.

items.statement: Like-to-like growth guidance of 5% to 7% for full year
items.quote: If I look at our guidance, we are guiding that we are looking at around 5% to 7% like-to-like in full price growth.

items.quote: AFL delivered yet another quarter of strong performance in muted market conditions. Our sales grew by around 7%, led by strong like-to-like growth of 11%.

items.statement: Bulk of like-to-like growth came from volume growth
items.quote: See, the bulk of the like-to-like growth has come from the volume growth. Majority.

items.quote: With lower discounting and richer channel mix in favor of direct channels, retail and online B2C, Q3 GP went up by 160 basis points to 55%.

items.quote: If the overall company has to grow at 100 basis points, the Arrow and Flying Machine growth -- EBITDA growth has to be higher than 100 basis points. That's what our plan is because there is a scope to take that forward.

items.quote: The growth in B2C will more than compensate any likely decline in B2B and overall online business is likely to grow close to 10% profitably with a healthy revenue mix of around 25%.

items.statement: Gross square foot addition of more than 1.5 lakh this year, highest ever

items.quote: We've been talking about pivoting away from B2B to B2C to better manage the consumer experience, better assortment, online exclusive, use of analytics better, lesser discounting, and more controlled discounting.

items.quote: We have filed the scheme with BSE and NSE, and I'm happy to report that we have received no objection from BSE and NSE, and we are targeting to file the scheme with MCA early next week.

items.quote: Consistent with our strategy to focus on increasing volumes, we have achieved an overall volume of 9.73 mmscmd during 9 months ended 31st December 2024, which is an increase of 5% over corresponding period in previous financial year.

items.statement: GSPC H1 FY25 turnover ~INR11,000 crores, EBITDA ~INR1,200 crores, PAT ~INR900 crores; gas trading volume ~11-12 mmscmd
items.quote: Yes, the half yearly, the company had a turnover of close to INR11,000 crores, and with an EBITDA of close to INR1,200 crores and a profit after tax of close to INR900 crores.

items.statement: Hydrogen blending pilot at 8% in NTPC Kawas colony (200 houses); targeting 15% post regulatory approvals; 3 CBG suppliers connected, 6 more agreements in process
items.quote: We have completed blending and testing at 8%. We originally started with 5%, then we have increased to 8%. 8% model has also been successfully proved. So now we are gearing up our system to increase it to 15%.

items.statement: Received 150+ customer responses for propane-linked GSA in Morbi; waiting for right timing to execute; Morbi market size 8-9 mmscmd, previously sold >7 mmscmd
items.quote: And for your -- that propane linked GSA, gas sales agreement, we have received more than 150 customers response . We are just waiting for the right time, right moment to get into that.

items.statement: Industrial VAT: selling at 15%, customer pays 6%, company claims 9% refund from government; CNG VAT ~5%
items.quote: No, the industrial, we are selling at 15%. And basically, we get a refund from the government -- if the customer pays 6 percentage, then 9% we claim a refund from the government.

items.statement: Credit rating maintained at AAA stable (long-term) and A1+ (short-term) from CARE, India Ratings, CRISIL post corporate announcement
items.quote: After the recent corporate announcement also, Gujarat Gas continues to have the credit rating of AAA stable for long term and A1+ for short term from CARE, India Ratings and CRISIL.

items.statement: Morbi volumes sensitive to propane-gas price spread; spot LNG prices volatile ($14-15 vs earlier $5-6 expectations); APM allocation fluctuating creating sourcing uncertainty
items.quote: The problem is the APM gas allocation is fluctuating. So once I know the final allocation or the scenario, which is there and the stability in the volumes, which are going to come in, then automatically, I will go and hedge it off against the long-term contract.

items.statement: Future sourcing portfolio to include blend of Brent and Henry Hub linked contracts; will announce new long-term agreements shortly
items.quote: So going forward, we will have our portfolio will have a combination of Brent as well as Henry Hub going forward. That's how we are looking at new agreements also.

items.statement: Targets Rs 1,000 crore revenue by FY29-FY30 and consolidated breakeven by FY27-FY28
items.quote: We are still holding on to our ambition, aspiration of crossing, of reaching Rs. 1,000 cross by FY29-FY30 in that range and by FY27-FY28 will be breakeven on a consol idated basis

items.statement: AGEasy to reach Rs 500 crore revenue before 5 years
items.quote: Absolutely, the it will be Rs. 500 crores before 5 years actually.

items.statement: Aims for AGEasy gross margin 55-60% next year and 60%+ in two years; CM2 positive in two years
items.quote: So, I think on a gross margin business, that is the first, we should look at about 55%-60% range next year, right, and a two-year timeframe, 60% plus, right?

items.statement: Gurgaon Phase-1 sold 240 of 292 units (82%); sales collections INR 124 crore
items.quote: We have 292 apartments as I said 240 already sold out. Sales collection of INR 124 crores and Antara continues to have a steady revenue income by way of management fees.

items.statement: Noida Phase-1 collections INR 382 crore with 99% collection efficiency
items.quote: Total collection achieved so far is INR 382 crores, 14% growth over last year. Our construction is as per plan and now we are doing all the finishing works, interiors, landscaping, etc.

items.statement: Dehradun community operational revenue INR 6.1 crore in Q3 FY25, up 13% YoY; 12 resales earned INR 2.2 crore marketing fee
items.quote: The operational revenue from Dehradun has increased to about Rs. 6.1 crores for Q3 FY25, a growth of 13% over the last corresponding quarter.

items.statement: Added 234 beds in Care Homes in FY25; total capacity now 300 beds; ~200 more beds in Chennai and Bangalore to go live in Q4
items.quote: We have added 234 new beds in Care Homes in the current financial year. Our bed capacity is now increased to 300. We also had planned to increase some more in Q4 of this year, which will happen as well.

items.statement: Plans 1.5 million sq ft annual development: 0.3M Noida Phase-2, 0.7-0.8M Chandigarh, ~1M Gurgaon Phase-2
items.quote: We have 0.3 of Noida Phase-2, potential 0.7-0.8 of Chandigarh and we will have possibly 1 million of Gurgaon Phase-2. So, the 1.5 is not a problem at all.

items.statement: AGEasy monthly revenue run-rate grew from Rs 52 lakh (Jun) to Rs 1.3 crore (Sep) to Rs 3 crore (Dec); 18,000 repeat customers; 1.93 lakh lives touched
items.quote: The AGEasy monthly revenue rate grew from Rs 52 lakhs in June to Rs. 1.3 crores in September to Rs. 3 crores in December and maybe we will cross that number in January as well.

items.statement: Care Home net revenue Rs 2.1 crore in Q3 FY25, up 22% QoQ and 40% YoY; ARPOB up 8%; Care at Home revenue Rs 4.6 crore, up 83% YoY
items.quote: The Care Home’s net revenue stood at Rs. 2.1 crores in Q3 F Y25, which is a growth of 22% over last quarter and Y-o-Y growth of about 40

items.statement: Care Home contribution margin improved from 12% in Q3 FY24 to 18% in Q3 FY25; mature Care Home target annual revenue Rs 5-6 crore
items.quote: Margins are sharply improved from 12% in Q3 F Y24 to 18% in Q3 FY25. We have served about 200 patients during Q3 FY25 and over 2000 patients in Care Home since inception

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA loss (ex-exceptional) Rs 24.7 crore in Q3 FY25 vs Rs 15.7 crore; treasury income and cost optimization containing losses
items.quote: The consolidated EBITDA loss excluding the exceptional item stand at Rs 24.7 Cr compared to Rs 15.7 Cr. It is a growth business and therefore we need the money for growth.

items.statement: Sourcing from China: placed Rs 5 crore order for 20 products; expected to improve gross margin by ~20% once supply chain stabilizes
items.quote: We have initiated our sourcing for China to improve our gross margins, already placed order worth Rs. 5 crores for 20 products which will improve our margin by about 20%.

items.statement: AGEasy product portfolio expanded to 60+ products, 180 SKUs; 10 new launches planned in Q4; Gut health condition launch in Q1 FY26
items.quote: We have planned for 10 new product launches in Q4 a nd Gut health as the next condition launch expected in Q1 FY26

items.statement: Partnerships with boAt (tech wearables), Dr Lal PathLabs (geriatric packages), Wellbeing Nutrition (nutraceuticals), Axis Bank (silver lining program), Axis Max Life (annuity plan)
items.quote: We onboarded Boat, as you know it is an admirable electronics organization in India, leading player in wearable and hearables, they are going to be our technology partner for AGEasy.

items.statement: AGEasy channel mix: 68% marketplaces, 22% D2C, 10% offline; target 55-45 to 60-40 marketplace vs D2C in 3 years with 10% offline
items.quote: Eventually, we should end up with a 55-45, 60-40 marketplaces versus D2C. And we have been advised to cede the offline channel right now because after 2-3 years, both marketplaces and our D2C website will tend to plateau.

items.statement: Working with NITI Aayog and Ministry of Social Justice to create task force for senior care insurance; NABH certification standards for Care Homes underway
items.quote: We have been trying to work both at an NITI Aayog level and Ministry of Social Justice to push the government to create a task force. Because we think insurance, once it comes into play for senior care, will be a big push to the business.

items.statement: Rights issue at Holdco level first; next $10-12 mn at subsidiary level (AGEasy or AACS) in 6-9 months; not diluting AGEasy specifically
items.quote: The rights issue will happen at the Hold co. level, which is the first branch of funding in the next $10-$12 million will happen at the subsidiary level perhaps.

items.statement: Care Home model asset-light: lease facilities, capex ~Rs 8-9 lakh/bed plus ~Rs 2 lakh operating losses; ~Rs 10 lakh/bed total investment
items.quote: We only take facilities on lease and the only CAPEX spend is about Rs 8 lakhs or Rs 9 lakhs on a bed and about Rs 2 lakhs, let us say on the operating losses with breakeven, so let us say Rs. 10 lakhs per bed is the kind of investment.

items.statement: NPS for AGEasy improved from 13 to 36 in last 6 months; customer satisfaction scores: Care Homes 92%, Care at Home 94%, AGEasy 84%
items.quote: NPS is extremely healthy, which vindicates the customers confidence in our offerings which is growing steadily from 13 to now 36 in the last 6 months.

items.statement: Noida Phase-2 delayed due to RERA; appellate authority resolution discussions underway; OC application for Phase-1 in abeyance due to Sector 150 issues
items.quote: We have now taken this up with appellate authority and resolution discussions are underway for these approvals. While there will be a delay in Phase-2, the silver lining in the market continues to be quite buoyant.

items.statement: Bangalore project exited due to lack of lender clearance from land owners; Hyderabad also deferred to prioritize Gurgaon Phase-2 and Chandigarh
items.quote: Unfortunately there the clearance we did not receive from the lenders of the land owners and there we never wanted to get into a project which is risky from day one, and that is why with these alternatives coming to us, we said let us play careful and that is the reason why we backed out from Bangalore.

items.statement: Long-term vision: 8-10 communities, 4,000-5,000 senior living units, 1,500-2,000 assisted living beds, AGEasy nationwide across chronic conditions
items.quote: Hopefully, the next 5-7 years, we will also keep our promise of creating 8-10 communities, 4,000-5,000 units of senior living, about 1,500-2,000 beds of assisted living plus Antara AGEasy available across India.

items.statement: Sustainable PBT margin for the industry is 12-15%
items.quote: The order profile is changing, and a normal margin for this kind of industry would be in the range of 12% to 15%.

items.statement: FY26 PBT margin expected to be healthy, above normalized 12-15% range
items.quote: Next financial year is primarily the existing orders where the margins are comparatively higher, better. So next financial year would be not 12% to 15%, but at the same time difficult to assign any kind of a number. But we expect healthy margins next financial year also.

items.statement: Three additional P-75 submarines order expected before 31st March 2025
items.quote: Additional submarines, we are quite hopeful that we are confident that it can be done before 31st March this year.

items.statement: P-75(I) price bids opened; MDL is the only technically suitable bidder; order expected next financial year
items.quote: The price bids have been opened, so a decision has already been taken that only one bid is technically suitable, that is the one submitted by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited. Price bids have been opened. We expect that anytime soon the negotiations or the discussions should start. items.statement: Next Generation Corvette price bids not yet opened; order finalization expected next financial year
items.quote: We have participated in the bid. The price bid is yet to be opened.

items.statement: Follow-on orders for 17 Bravo frigates and Next Generation Destroyers expected to fructify in 2-3 years
items.quote: Large order is not there, but discussion is there with regard to 17, follow on of 17 Alpha, that is 17 Bravo, and with respect to next generation destroyers. So a firming up at the Naval end has not taken place, but we expect between 2 to 3 years from now, these two projects should be fructifying.

items.statement: AIP order worth Rs. 1,768 crore received in December for Scorpene mid-life upgrade
items.quote: AIP order for approximately Rs. 1768 crores we have already received in the month of December.

items.statement: Capex of ~Rs. 500 crore in FY26 mainly for floating dry dock completion
items.quote: It is around Rs. 500 crores CAPEX is there, approximately. So that balance will get realized completely in the next financial year. Rs. 350 crores will get realized at that time.

items.statement: Two major capex programs: adjacent land graving dry dock and Nhava Yard development; DPRs by mid-2025, then EPC tendering
items.quote: We have two CAPEX programs. One for the adjacent land which we need to be developed with a graving dry dock. items.statement: P-75 delivery timeline: 6 years from order for first submarine, then one per year
items.quote: Six years from the date of placement or receipt of order and then subsequent submarines each one year, additional one year for each submarine.

items.statement: P-75(I) delivery timeline: 7 years from contract signing for first submarine, then one per year
items.quote: Seven years on signing of the contract for the first one and one year subsequent for the remaining submarines.

items.statement: No revenue decline expected in FY26; marginal growth possible from existing order backlog
items.quote: next year? Sanjeev Singhal: We are not saying that next year growth is not projected at 20%. We are saying that there would not be a decline in next year revenues. Growth numbers have not been worked out. There could be a marginal growth

items.quote: SM5, we have reversed around Rs. 142 crores.

items.statement: LD provisions for Scorpene submarines 1 (~Rs. 100 crore) and 6 to be pursued for waiver; reversal timing uncertain
items.quote: The fourth submarine, I mean submarine one, is still under discussion. There the provision is in the range of Rs. 100 crores because the LD applicability for the first submarine was at the rate of 2.5%. On others, it was applicable at the rate of 5%. This is still under discussion. We are pursuing that. And with regard to the sixth submarine, again we have now delivered it in the month of January.

items.statement: No major platform deliveries expected in Q4 FY25; one definite and possibly two in FY26
items.quote: In this financial year, no deliveries are expected. We are not expecting any further delivery in this financial year. Next financial year, one is definite, could be two.

items.statement: Export discussions ongoing with Brazil, Indonesia, others; small-scale support to Malaysia submarines underway; conversion to orders takes time
items.quote: These visits by the foreign nationals are steps towards converting them into exports. They take time, they don't happen overnight because there are a lot of issues involved when it comes to export, bilateral issues basically. So at the moment, we have already started some amount of export to Malaysia, but that's at a very small scale. We are supporting their submarines. So as and when things get c

items.statement: No budgetary constraints seen for firm proposals; defence capex allocation up ~5% overall
items.quote: As far as the budgetary allocation is concerned for the CAPEX, there is an increase of around 5% on an overall basis, considering all the three wings. But our experience states that whatever is the requirement, whatever proposals are firmed up, there is no dearth of funding or none of the proposals have been stalled by the government.

items.statement: Goa Shipyard is an associate (47.21% stake), not a subsidiary; no management control or listing plans
items.quote: Goa Shipyard is not our subsidiary, they are our associate company. We are holding 47.21%. Currently, there is no management control, it is just an investment in Goa Shipyard. We don't participate in their production programs or any kind of decision making. They are an independent company.

items.statement: Environmental clearance uncertainty for Nhava Yard and adjacent land capex projects
items.quote: There is the uncertainty of environmental clearance which are there. So it's a slightly long process for coming to fruition.

items.statement: Existing order book executable over approximately 2-2.5 years
items.quote: Approximately 2-2.5 years.

items.statement: Negative 4% value growth in Q3 FY25; demand slowdown persistent for almost a year; festive demand fell short of expectations
items.quote: After reporting an industry leading growth for 6 consecutive quarters, we ourselves are disappointed to report a ne gative top-line growth during this quarter. The demand slowdown has been persistent for almost a year now and the festive demand fell way short of expectations

items.statement: Standalone gross margin 47.2% in Q3 FY25 vs 48.4% YoY; EBITDA margin 17.5% vs 17.8% YoY; PAT margin 11.0% vs 10.9% YoY
items.quote: As usual, we have maintained the pole position in terms of gross margins which stood at 47.2%. The gross margins were slightly muted compared to the corresponding period of the previous year when it was 48.4%, partially due to the price cuts taken by the industry in Q4 of last year and somewhat due to the change in product mixes which happened.

items.statement: Expect high single-digit growth in Q4 FY25; may achieve small double-digit growth if lucky; gradual month-on-month recovery expected
items.quote: we'll be happy if we do high single-digit growth in this quarter. If we are lucky, we may end up doing small double-digit growth as far as this quarter is concerned, but we have to wait and watch.

items.statement: Water-based paint plant at Jodhpur expected commissioning by Q3 FY26; solvent-based plant by Q1 FY26; putty plant brownfield expansion by Q1 FY26
items.quote: Due to minor delays in civil construction, the water-based paint plant is now expected to be commissioned by Q3 of FY '26, while the solvent-based plant is expected to be up and running by Q1 of FY '26. The brownfield expansion at Jodhpur of the putty plant will also be completed by Q1 of FY '26.

items.statement: Enough capacity to cater to existing demand; Jodhpur capex delays not expected to cause adverse impact
items.quote: This minor delay is not expected to cause any adverse impact as we have enough capacity to cater to the existing demand.

items.statement: Emulsion volumes grew 1.7% YoY, value growth 2.8%; premium emulsions outperformed economy segment indicating mix improvement
items.quote: On a volume basis, our emulsion volumes grew by 1.7% this quarter compared to the same quarter of the last fiscal, and the value growth in the emulsion category was even higher at 2.8%. This demonstrates that our premium emulsions have done better than our economy emulsion segment, implying an improvement in our product mix.

items.statement: Industry price cuts in Q3-Q4 FY24 impacted gross margins ~100 bps YoY; no further price drops expected; pricing power rests with market leader

items.quote: I would say that we have been even impacted to a lesser extent by Birla Opus. items.statement: Trade inventory fairly low; dealers keeping minimum stock due to weak demand; no push sales to prop up P&L
items.quote: At the moment, I would say that the trade level inventory, at least as far as Indigo is concerned, is fairly low. And as the sentiment changes, we would expect the dealers to start stocking up.

items.statement: Zero debt; capex funded from internal accruals; treasury investments ~INR196 cr as of Dec 31, 2024
items.quote: our treasury balance is about INR196 crores as on 31st December. And this is after all the internal funding that is happening for the capex. items.statement: Waterproofing and construction chemicals contribute healthy mid-single-digit to revenue

items.statement: Demand slowdown unprecedented across consumer products and paint sector; hope for recovery from good monsoon, budget tax cuts, RBI rate cuts

items.statement: Consolidated revenue from operations grew 27.5% YoY, declined 0.6% QoQ to INR 772 cr; EBITDA pre-IndAS grew 34.7% YoY, declined 10% QoQ to INR 198 cr; EBITDA pre-IndAS margin 23.3%
items.quote: Consolidated revenue from operations grew by 27.5% on year-on-year, and it declined by 0.6% on quarter-on-quarter basis, INR 772 crores. Consolidated EBITDA pre IndAS grew by 34.7% on a year-on-year and declined by 10% on quarter-on-quarter basis to INR 198 crore.

items.statement: Average revenue per operating bed grew 25.2% YoY and 0.5% QoQ; average revenue per patient grew 12.2% YoY and 2.8% QoQ; IP volume grew 13.8% YoY, declined 3.1% QoQ
items.quote: Operational highlights consolidated, average revenue per operating bed grew by 25.2% and 0.5% on year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter basis respectively. Average revenue per patient grew by 12.2% and 2.8% on year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter basis respectively. IP volume grew by 13.8% and declined by 3.1% on year-on-year and a quarter-on-quarter basis respectively.

items.quote: we are happy to announce the opening of 200-bedded multispeciality hospital at Guntur on a O&M basis called KIMS-SIKHARA at Guntur, a very important town in Andhra Pradesh near the capital city of Amravati. Honorable Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, Sri Chandrababu Naidu Gara has kindly consented to inaugurate this hospital on 12th February of this month.

items.statement: Kannur hospital to add 50 beds by end FY25, another 100-150 beds in 2 years reaching 350-400 beds; Kollam to commence operations from April; Thrissur to start in 12-15 months; all Kerala hospitals to focus on tertiary/quaternary care
items.quote: We are planning to add another 50 beds by end of this financial year in the same campus. And maybe another 2 years from now, we should be able to add another 100, 150 beds in the Kannur facility, taking up to 350, 400 beds.

items.statement: Bangalore: 2 hospitals commissioning this FY, third on land to start construction next FY (3-year build); targeting 2,000 beds in Bangalore over time; also exploring 750-1,000 beds in North Bangalore over 3-4 years
items.quote: In Karnataka the plan should be that we scale up to at least 2,000 beds in Bangalore over a period of time. At this point, we have 2 hospitals that will get commissioned in this financial year. items.statement: Capex guidance unchanged; outstanding debt INR 1,550 cr as of 31 Dec 2024; expected to reach INR 1,750 cr range; debt/equity below 1:1, debt/EBITDA below 2:1
